name: columnKey
label: Column key
description: The key of the column that the filter was applied to.

name: oldValue
label: Old value
description: The previous filter value. May be empty if the filter did not exist or if the previous operator did not require a value.

name: newValue
label: New value
description: The new filter value. May be empty if the filter is cleared or if the operator does not require a value. May be the same as the old value if other parts of the filter have changed.

name: oldOperator
label: Old operator
description: The old filter operator. May be empty if the filter did not exist.

name: newOperator
label: New operator
description: The new filter operator. May be the same as the old operator if other parts of the filter have changed.
